items:
Summary:

Highlights:

5 Bed, 5.5 Bath, Sleeps 16

Private Pool (Heated & Cooled on Request)

3-Story Luxury Beach Home w/ First Floor Kitchen

6 Adult Bikes with Each Reservation

24/7 Professional Management & Safe & Contact-Free, Keyless Check-in



The Space:

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 16):

- Master Suite I, First Floor: King Bed, Private Bath with Walk-in Shower

- Master Suite II, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bath with Walk-in Shower and Soaking Tub

- Master Suite III, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bath with Walk-in Shower 

- Bunk Room I, Second Floor: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed, Private Bath with Walk-in Shower

- Bunk Room II, Third Floor: Five Bunk Beds - Two (2) Sets of Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds [4 Bunk Beds], (1) Middle Twin Bunk Bed [1 Bunk Bed], (1) Queen Pull Out Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bath with Walk-in Shower

- Media Room/Den, Third Floor: Queen Pull Out Sleeper Sofa



Reasons to Book Sealestial in Seacrest Beach on 30A Today:

- 5 Bedrooms / 5.5 Bathrooms, Accommodates 16

- Located in Seacrest Beach Community

- Private Pool Heatable/Coolable (On Request)*

- Brand New (2024) Home!

- 6 Adult Bikes with Each Reservation

- 4 Minute Walk to Largest Resort Style Pool on 30A

- 2 Covered Patios/Porches

- 3 Covered Balconies with Seating

- Quick Walk to the Beach

- Fully Appointed Kitchen

- Dining Room

- Breakfast Bar

- Full Size Refrigerator With Ice Maker

- Full Size Gas Stove With Oven

- Granite Countertops

- Pots, Pans, & Cooking Utensils Provided

- Blender, Toaster, Dishes & Eating Utensils Provided

- Complimentary Wireless Internet

- Resort Linens and Towels Provided (Excludes Beach Towels)

- Full Size Washer & Dryer

- K-Cup & Standard (drip-style) Coffee Machines

- Propane Grill (Propane Provided)

- Seasonal Tram Service

- Close to Restaurants



*Private Pool: The private pool at Sealestial at Seacrest Beach on 30A can be heated or chilled upon request for $65 per night, with payment required in full at the time of request and approval. The fee applies only for consecutive nights, and intermittent requests will not be accepted or accommodated.



During warmer months, the pool temperature can be adjusted for cooling. During colder months, the pool will be heated to a maximum temperature of 90 degrees. Any tampering, alteration, or modification of the pool equipment without explicit, written consent or direction from the property management is strictly prohibited. Violations of this policy will result in a fine, in addition to any repair or replacement costs incurred.



Please be advised that both heating and cooling are subject to external weather conditions, and the actual pool temperature may fluctuate accordingly, as these factors are outside of our control. In accordance with state law, all private pools are required to have alarms on doors and windows that lead to the pool as a safety measure. This property is equipped with the mandated alarms. Any tampering, disabling, or modification of these alarms is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate eviction, without refund or compensation, in addition to any applicable fines.



Relaxation and adventure await at our brand new (built in 2024) Sealestial at Seacrest Beach on 30A; boasting 3,000 square feet and offering accommodations for up to 16 guests in 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms.



Parking & Transportation:

- Parking: There is parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway.

- Bicycles: Enjoy 6 adult bikes to explore 30A in style.

- Seacrest Beach Seasonal Beach & Pool Shuttle/Tram Service: Seasonal service from March through October, providing easy transportation within the community, including to the beach and pool.

- Golf Cart/LSV (Low Speed Vehicle): Effective January 1st, 2022, Golf carts, low-speed vehicles (LSVs), Mokes, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), go-carts, motor scooters or similar motorized vehicles are prohibited within Seacrest Beach.



Guest Access:

Beach & Pool Access:

- Deeded Beach Access: The Seacrest Beach North Community enjoys private, deeded beach access through the Sunset Beach Community.

- Pool Access: The Seacrest Community pool is the largest resort style pool on 30A available for Seacrest Beach guests. At over 12,000 square feet, it’s one of the largest resort-style pools on 30A—perfect for a refreshing swim

- Beach Towels: Not provided.

- Beach Chairs: Beach chairs may be located at the property during your reservation but are not guaranteed.



Seacrest Beach Seasonal Beach & Pool Shuttle/Tram Service:

- Seasonal service from March through October, providing easy transportation within the community, including to the beach and pool.



Nearby Attractions:

- Restaurants: Within walking distance to popular dining spots like Crabby Steve's, La Cocina Mexican Grill, George’s at Alys Beach, and The Donut Hole.

- Shopping & Entertainment: Close to the Village of South Walton, offering shops, bike rentals, and more.



Seacrest Beach Amenity Packet:

Before arrival, guests must complete an online registration form to receive their amenity wristbands and parking passes. This form will ask for the following details:

Contact information

Rental address

Arrival & departure dates

Number of adults (11 & older) and children (10 & younger)

Year, make, model, color, and tag number of all vehicles parking at the residence

After completing the registration, you’ll receive directions for picking up your wristbands before check-in, ensuring a smooth and easy arrival.



The Neighborhood:

Seacrest Beach is a colorful beach community nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. This easy going neighborhood, identifiable by the large beach chair at the front of the community and palm lined streets, is the perfect place to spend your next getaway boasting a 12,000 square foot community pool. Seacrest Beach is within walking or biking distance to the Emerald Coast's famous sugar white beaches and steps to the Seacrest Town Center or Rosemary Beach. The Seacrest Beach town center is located at The Village of South Walton, featuring delectable dining options, shops and bike rentals. Centered within the community is the Seacrest Lagoon. The community pool, open year round, is an impressive 378,000 gallons making it one of the largest community pools in Florida. The amphitheater is a grassy area where concerts, movies, and weddings are held. It can also be a great place for catch or a sunny picnic.



Other Things to Note:

Age Requirement: Please note our age requirement policy for March/April: One (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 be present and staying in the property for every three (3) guests between the ages of 15 and 25.



Two Night Reservations: Please note, two (2) night reservations are subject to a lower max occupancy. A two night reservation max sleeping capacity is equal to half of the standard max occupancy restriction for the property.



Promotions, Rates, Availability, Closures, Construction, and Cancellations:

* Promotions may change, be cancelled and dates may be blacked out at BeachWalk's sole discretion and without notice.

* Rates, availability and minimum stay requirements are subject to change without notice.

*Please check Walton/Okaloosa County local news outlets for up-to-date information on closures or construction that may affect your vacationeachWalk is not responsible for any disruptions caused by nearby construction or closures of community amenities, such as pools or other shared facilities, as these are managed by the respective Homeowners' Associations and may impact your overall experience.

*Cancellation of the reservation within a certain period prior to check-in may result in forfeiture of the payment or a cancellation fee, depending on the timing of the request.



No Pets: No pets of any kind are permitted. No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



No Smoking or Vaping: Smoking in any form (e.g. cigarettes, cigars, “e-cigarettes” or “vapes”) are not permitted. No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



No Golf Cart/LSV (Low Speed Vehicle): Effective January 1st, 2022, Golf carts, low-speed vehicles (LSVs), Mokes, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), go-carts, motor scooters or similar motorized vehicles are prohibited within Seacrest Beach.



Exterior Surveillance Noticer: For the security of our guests and the property, exterior security cameras are in place. These may include, but are not limited to, a front doorbell camera, driveway camera, cameras monitoring balconies, and a camera overseeing the pool area. These devices are positioned to ensure safety while respecting guest privacy.



Shipping & Mailbox Disclaimer: Please be advised that BeachWalk Vacation Properties does not have access to the mailbox associated with this property. Any items shipped to the home are done so at your own risk. BeachWalk Vacation Properties assumes no responsibility for lost, misplaced, or stolen items. Should you require specific shipping instructions or if an item is delivered and cannot be located, we strongly recommend contacting the shipping carrier directly to explore alternative solutions.



Interaction with Guests:

Questions?

Contact us by responding to our Confirmation/Welcome Message.

Confirmation will be emailed and/or texted upon booking.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
